visualCharacteristics.purpose: standalone embedded video player (Brightcove player or playlist on the source)

contentPattern.structure: the video URL as a link (YouTube, Vimeo, Brightcove, Vidyard, Wistia or .mp4); optional poster picture; optional caption text

reuseGuidance: Use for a video on its own. With a poster picture, the player loads on click; without one it loads when scrolled into view. For a video beside copy use columns-feature.
decisions: Brightcove playlist sidebars render inside the Brightcove iframe when the authored URL is the playlist player URL; no custom playlist UI is built.
